# EC P-256 test certificates for TLS 1.3 CertificateVerify + trust tests.
# root_cert: self-signed CA. leaf_cert/leaf_key: valid leaf (CN/SAN=localhost) signed by root.
# expired_cert: leaf signed by root but validity 2020..2021 (expired).
# wrongname_cert: valid leaf signed by root with SAN=other.example.
# otherhost_cert/otherhost_key: a self-signed leaf for SAN=other.example with its own key (a second
#   virtual host whose credential pairs; generated with openssl, valid 100 years).
# root2_cert: an unrelated CA (for the untrusted-root case). Scheme: ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256.
# ipsan_leaf_cert: a self-signed leaf whose SAN is IP:127.0.0.1, IP:::1, DNS:localhost (for the
#   IP-literal identity match; only its SANs are read, it is not chain-validated).
# leaf_pfx: PKCS#12 of leaf_cert + leaf_key with root_cert as the CA bag, password "tlslib"
#   (openssl pkcs12 -export -inkey leaf.pem -in leaf.pem -certfile root.pem -passout pass:tlslib,
#   OpenSSL 3.2 defaults). Its leaf is CN/SAN=localhost, so loopback examples verify the name.
